strava.credentialsDescription: Enter your personal Strava API credentials to connect your account
strava.howToGetCredentials: How to get your Strava API credentials:
strava.step1: Go to https://www.strava.com/settings/api and create a new application
strava.step2: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from your Strava app settings
strava.step3: Get your Access Token and Refresh Token from your Strava app
strava.step4: Enter all four credentials below to connect your Strava account
strava.credentialsError: Failed to save Strava credentials. Please check your values and try again.
strava.securityNote: Your credentials are encrypted and stored securely. They are only used to sync your Strava data.

oura.credentialsDescription: Enter your personal Oura API credentials to connect your Oura Ring
oura.howToGetCredentials: How to get your Oura API credentials:
oura.step1: Go to https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications and create a new application
oura.step2: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from your Oura app settings
oura.step3: Use these credentials to set up OAuth flow for your users
oura.step4: Enter your Client ID and Client Secret below to connect your Oura Ring
oura.credentialsError: Failed to save Oura credentials. Please check your values and try again.
oura.securityNote: Your credentials are encrypted and stored securely. They are only used to sync your Oura Ring data.
